content-seo.q: What content generates qualified organic leads?
content-seo.a: Service, use-case, comparison and decision guides can connect high-intent searches to enquiries. Choose topics from real buyer questions.

content-seo.q: How do I build topical authority without publishing daily?
content-seo.a: Cover a focused subject thoroughly with useful primary detail, connect related pages and keep them accurate. A publishing quota alone does not build trust.

content-seo.q: Can content help my brand appear in AI answers?
content-seo.a: Clear, original explanations with visible expertise can be easier to cite. Review citations and referral behaviour rather than promising placement.

content-seo.q: Should I refresh old blog posts for SEO?
content-seo.a: Refresh when facts, products or intent have changed. Improve the answer and relevant internal paths, then measure the affected page group.

content-seo.q: How do I choose blog keywords that lead to sales?
content-seo.a: Map the full decision journey and prioritise questions that connect naturally to products or services, not only the largest search volume.

local-seo.q: How do I rank in Google Maps near my customers?
local-seo.a: Keep an eligible Business Profile accurate, explain services clearly and earn authentic reviews. Relevance, distance and prominence shape results.

local-seo.q: Can a service-area business rank without a storefront?
local-seo.a: It may be eligible if it meets Google's rules and serves customers in person. Configure the profile honestly and explain real coverage on the site.

local-seo.q: Do local landing pages help organic leads?
local-seo.a: Yes when each page has genuine coverage, local context and a useful action. City names pasted into duplicate copy are weak.

local-seo.q: What local SEO keywords should I target?
local-seo.a: Look at service-plus-area searches, neighbourhood language and customer questions, then verify what appears in the actual local results.

local-seo.q: How do I measure calls from local search?
local-seo.a: Use Business Profile data alongside site analytics and enquiry tracking, while accounting for attribution limits and a clear baseline.

ecommerce-seo.q: How can an online store rank product pages on Google?
ecommerce-seo.a: Use unique product details, crawlable links, valid structured data and clear availability; prioritise pages with buying demand.

ecommerce-seo.q: What is the best SEO structure for ecommerce categories?
ecommerce-seo.a: Organise categories around how customers shop, keep filters controlled and link clearly to valuable subcategories and products.

ecommerce-seo.q: Can ecommerce SEO increase sales instead of traffic?
ecommerce-seo.a: Yes when category and product searches match purchase intent and reporting connects organic landing pages to revenue.

ecommerce-seo.q: How should I handle out-of-stock products for SEO?
ecommerce-seo.a: Keep useful pages live when stock will return, offer alternatives and avoid redirecting unrelated products. Set expectations clearly.

ecommerce-seo.q: How do I prevent faceted navigation from creating duplicate pages?
ecommerce-seo.a: Decide which filtered combinations deserve indexable pages, control the rest and verify canonicals and crawl paths on the actual store.
